preconditions.description: The number of queries q must be between 1 and 10.
Each string a and b must have a length between 1 and 100,000.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in a + b)
preconditions.description: Both strings a and b must contain only lowercase English letters.

postconditions.description: The output must be either -1 or a palindromic string.

postconditions.expression: any(stdout.startswith(a[i:j]) and stdout.endswith(b[k:l]) for i in range(len(a)) for j in range(i+1, len(a)+1) for k in range(len(b)) for l in range(k+1, len(b)+1))
postconditions.description: The output string must be a concatenation of a non-empty substring of a and a non-empty substring of b.

postconditions.expression: len(stdout) == max(len(s) for s in valid_strings)
postconditions.description: The output string must be the longest possible palindromic string formed from substrings of a and b.
